author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Sharp frontal studio headshot: buzz cut about 1 cm, full brown beard about 4-5 cm, blue-grey eyes, chest hair. Best image for eye colour and spacing, brows, nose width and beard outline. Bright, slightly overexposed studio light (skin reads lighter and pinker than in arena photos).

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body three-quarter cutout (body turned to his left) in red Venum shorts with a dark-red wave pattern and a black UFC waistband. Current look: buzz cut and full beard. Shows lean, defined physique with visible abs, long arms, moderate body hair on chest, belly and legs; no tattoos.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body three-quarter cutout (body turned to his right) in red Venum shorts with gold gloves. Shows his 2023-2024 hairstyle: sides and back shaved (undercut) with the long top tied into a high topknot on the crown. Clearest chest-hair view.

author: Show Jana Krause (YouTube still, uploaded to Commons)
notes: Czech TV interview just after he won the title and cut off his long hair: shaved head, beard about 3 cm, smiling, head turned slightly to his left so his right ear and cheek face the camera. Best three-quarter view of the cheekbones, nose and right ear (smooth, only slight thickening). Warm stage lighting. Attribution: 'Show Jana Krause, CC BY 3.0'.

author: Getty Images (ID 2239284585)
notes: Near-profile of the face (facing frame right, so his right side is toward the camera) while throwing a long straight punch. Fight-night head shaved smooth, beard about 4 cm. Best view of the nose profile (long, straight to faintly convex), forehead slope and how the beard projects from the chin. Also shows his long, lean arms and red Venum shorts with white slash marks.

author: Cageside Press
notes: Seated at the media-day table in a white, blue and red track jacket (Czech flag colours), head slightly turned to his left (right ear toward the camera). Buzz cut, beard about 3-4 cm with a lighter, reddish-blond cast under warm light. Low resolution.

author: Unknown agency photographer (published by theScore with a 'Takeaways' overlay)
notes: Close three-quarter from below, looking up and to his right. Very sharp: blue eyes, brow shape, nose underside and nostrils, beard density, and the LEFT ear, which shows clear cauliflower swelling (lumpy, thickened upper ear). Red arena light casts pink on the skin; do not use for skin colour.
